objects.description: [Storm-0501](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1053) has utilized [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) for C2 communications and used a unique “license_id” of “666.”(Citation: Microsoft Storm-501 Sabbath Ransomware Embargo September 2024)
objects.description_fa: [Storm-0501](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1053) از [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) برای ارتباطات C2 استفاده کرده و از یک "license_id" منحصر به فرد "666" استفاده کرده است.(Citation: Microsoft Storm-501 Sabbath Ransomware Embargo September 2024)
